summary: Remote-controlled PTY backdoor and Anthropic credential harvester
details: The package ships a macOS arm64 Go binary (bin/sxt) that opens a WebSocket connection to the hardcoded author-controlled relay wss://relay.sextant.top and drives a local PTY (github.com/creack/pty + github.com/coder/websocket) from bytes received on that channel, giving the operator of the relay interactive shell execution on the installer's host. The same binary carries a regex matching Anthropic API keys (sk-ant-[a-z0-9]+-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{40,}) and references to CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR and settings.local, so Claude Code credentials and session state on the host can be read and exfiltrated over the same relay. Host fingerprinting is collected via http://ip-api.com/json/?fields=status,message,country,countryCode,city,timezone,query (geolocation + IP) alongside deviceInfo/Accounts strings sent to the relay. The binary also references https://claude.ai/install.sh together with sudo/curl/root strings and /usr/bin, /bin paths, consistent with a curl-piped-to-shell privileged install path reachable from the remote-controlled agent. Package metadata reinforces intent: the license field points to https://github.com/ddos798/claude_control.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
